prompt: The three reviewers assess the same current-task work through the same testability lens, using different models. Decide from their reports alone; do not inspect files, run tools, edit work or the plan, or make commits. Reviewers advise; neither majority voting nor unanimity determines acceptance. Consolidate duplicate findings and resolve conflicting suggestions with the smallest change that preserves the seed's behavior. Set satisfied to false only for concrete blocking defects or barriers to testing in the current task. Include an actionable findings array for required revisions, preserving file references and evidence. Set satisfied to true with an empty findings array when no required revisions remain. Do not reject unfinished future tasks, stylistic preferences, or speculative abstractions. Include a short summary explaining acceptance or rejection, and why any conflicting or nonblocking suggestions were not required.
